search_issues.description: Find the Jira issues that match a search, written in JQL, Jira's search language. To find the overdue ones, turn on Only overdue issues instead and write no search.

parameters.description: Which issues to find, in JQL, Jira's search language. For example: project = PROJ AND status = 'In Progress'. End with ORDER BY assignee (or ORDER BY updated DESC) to have the issues come back grouped or ranked that way, with no sorting step. Leave it empty when you turn on Only overdue issues.
parameters.name: jql

parameters.description: Beta. Turn on to get every issue that is not yet done, oldest first within each person. Needs no search written; replaces Search. With Only assigned issues, by_person already groups them per person with their issues written as lines, for a message to each person about what is on their plate.
parameters.name: open_only

parameters.description: Beta. Turn on to get the issues that are past their due date and not finished, the longest overdue first. Needs no search written; replaces Search.
parameters.name: overdue_only

parameters.description: Beta. Turn on by giving a number of days to get the issues finished in the last this many days (7 for a weekly recap), grouped by assignee. Needs no search written; replaces Search.

parameters.name: project

parameters.description: Beta. With Only open issues, Only overdue issues or Finished in the last days: leave out issues nobody is assigned to, for a message to each person about their own. The result's by_person (beta) already groups them per person, with their issues written as lines, so no grouping or joining step is needed.

jira_issue_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time an issue moves to another status in Jira, such as from In Progress to Done, with who moved it and when.

output.assignee: Who it is assigned to: displayName, emailAddress, accountId.
output.changed_by: Who moved it: displayName, emailAddress, accountId.
output.due_date: Its due date, if it has one.
output.issue_type: The issue type, such as Bug or Task.
output.key: The issue key, such as ENG-123.
output.project_key: The project's key, such as ENG.
output.reporter: Who reported it: displayName, emailAddress, accountId.
output.status: Its status, such as In Progress.
output.status_category: Its status category: To Do, In Progress or Done.
